Job Description: 
 Job Title – Mainframe MQ & WebSphere Application Server (WAS) - Lead Systems Programmer 
 The Purpose of This Role 
Provide technical and systems support to Mainframe MQ & WAS systems, with strong expertise in middleware administration, application hosting, integration, performance management, and production support. The ideal candidate should possess deep hands-on experience in IBM WebSphere Application Server (WAS) administration across complex enterprise environments, along with a solid understanding of IBM MQ on z/OS (Mainframe). 
The role will primarily focus on WAS administration, engineering, migration, performance optimization, security implementation, and platform modernization initiatives, while also supporting IBM MQ infrastructure on Mainframe and distributed platforms. 
 The Value You Deliver 
The Mainframe MQ group provides a variety of services related to MQ & WAS on z/OS systems at Fidelity. Those services might include but are not necessarily limited to: 
WebSphere Application Server (WAS) platform on z/OS 
Responsible in ensuring that the WebSphere Application Server for z/OS platform remains stable, secure, performant, and available for business-critical applications running on the Mainframe. 
Key contributor in maintaining middleware reliability and enabling seamless application delivery across development, test, and production environments. 
Platform Availability & Reliability 
Application Hosting & Deployment Excellence 
Performance Optimization 
Incident Resolution & Problem Management 
Security & Compliance 
Operational Excellence & Automation 
Mainframe Integration & Enterprise Support by working with MQ, CICS, DB2, z/OS System Programming, and Application teams. 
Working knowledge of Compute Grid augmentation into Cell 
Compute Grid configuration and operational support 
Working knowledge of ZFS administration 
Proficiency in Scripting for deployments 
Working knowledge of ZRES build and configuration 
undefined IBM MQ for z/OS infrastructure Maintain stable operation of MQ Queue Managers and Queue Sharing Groups (QSGs). 
Prevent message loss, duplication, and delivery disruptions. Support business-critical transactions that depend on MQ messaging. 
Administer Queue Sharing Groups and Shared Queues for continuous service availability. Support disaster recovery, failover, and resilience testing activities. 
Ensure MQ infrastructure can recover quickly from failures without business impact. Diagnose and resolve MQ failures impacting business applications. 
Investigate channel outages, queue build-ups, triggering issues, and connectivity failures. Perform root cause analysis for recurring incidents. 
Collaborate with application, z/OS, network, and distributed MQ teams during critical incident Assist application teams in implementing reliable messaging solutions. 
Contribute to modernization initiatives leveraging MQ as an enterprise integration backbone As a MQ Systems programmer, install, maintain, and provide 24X7 support for MQ z/OS and other related products

You would be able to contribute in maintaining stability of our end points by upkeeping infrastructure uptime through structured software, distribution and patch management mechanism thereby helping associates to perform their day to day tasks seamlessly.
